learning.hypothesis: The full-page phone screenshot of Home with the Continue card shows a white band at the bottom and a near-invisible Settings button. The card makes Home taller than 844 px, so it scrolls. Either the page background does not cover scrolled content (a real defect, possibly pre-existing at 360x640), or Chromium full-page capture does not paint the fixed body background beyond the first viewport (an artifact). A viewport screenshot after scrolling to the bottom shows what a player sees; repeating it at 360x640 without the card shows whether it predates this branch.

Viewport screenshots after scrolling show the dark background and a readable Settings button at 390x844 with the card and at 360x640 without it, so the white band was a Chromium full-page capture artifact of the fixed body background, not a player-facing defect.
